_about: Recommendations (R6). rec_outcomes is an ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE: how often a kind of recommendation was applied and how often the request or reply that included it was approved or overturned. It is demo data, not Harvest's history and not a prediction; every screen that shows it says so. rec_baseline is the sample starting approval rate the expected figure builds from. rec_decisions holds what clinicians did with each suggestion (the suggestions themselves are computed from stored records, web/js/shared/recs.js).
